lines.text: Every high priest offers gifts and sacrifices, but if Jesus were on earth, He would not be a priest.
Moses was warned to build the tabernacle according to the pattern shown him by King David.
God found fault with the people and promised a new covenant, unlike the one made when leading them out of Babylon.
